sources.title: VQC-ZTI: Variational Quantum Control for Zero Trust Protection of the ...
sources.snippet: This paper presents VQC-ZTI, a split-plane Variational Quantum Classifier framework for zero-trust protection of Tactile Internet services, in which an off-path VQC analyzes encrypted-flow telemetry while an on-path policy engine applies cached deterministic grant, restrict, step-up, and deny actions.
